_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Mary set out and hurried to the hills.
She came to Elizabeth's door with the good news in her.
At the sound of her voice the child leaped for joy.
Blessed are you, and blessed is the child you carry.
He has lifted up the lowly and filled the hungry.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
Come, let us worship the God who keeps his promise.
We rejoice in God our Savior. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Picture two women at a doorway in the hill country — one old and long past hope, one young and only beginning — and the whole promise of God between them.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
At Mary's greeting the child kicks and leaps in Elizabeth's body, joy quickening before a word is spoken.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
For God has looked on the lowly and remembered his mercy, casting down the mighty and lifting the poor from the dust.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
He fills the hungry with good things and keeps the promise made to our mothers and fathers long ago.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
